description: Source code for an OpenAI language model wrapper class, including methods for chat completion, streaming, and model handling.

classes.name: OpenAI
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLM to interact with OpenAI's API, supporting chat and completion functionalities.

methods.name: isOSeriesOrGpt5Model
methods.description: Checks if the model is an o-series or gpt-5 model.

methods.name: extraBodyProperties
methods.description: Returns additional body properties for requests, currently empty.

methods.name: getMaxStopWords
methods.description: Determines maximum stop words based on API base URL.

methods.name: _convertArgs
methods.description: Converts options and messages into ChatCompletionCreateParams, applying model-specific adjustments.

methods.name: _getHeaders
methods.description: Returns headers for API requests, including authorization.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Performs a chat completion for a prompt, concatenating streamed chunks.

methods.name: _getEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URL based on the provided endpoint string.

methods.name: _streamComplete
methods.description: Streams chat completion responses, yielding rendered chat messages.

methods.name: modifyChatBody
methods.description: Modifies chat request body for specific models and streaming options.

methods.name: _legacystreamComplete
methods.description: Handles legacy streaming completions via SSE.

methods.name: _streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat responses, handling legacy and current endpoints.
